_comment: content.map fragment for templates/_library/sections/hero. Rule reference: editor-fill.js header comment. 'from':'hero' is Create Event's hero-shape library id; its own special fields (hero.title/hero.tagline/hero.cta1/hero.cta2 — not the generic subheading/heading/body/cta slots other sections use) plus the step-1 event fields (event.logo/event.date/event.location) are exactly what ported templates' own banner sections map (see templates/making-ai-work/template.json and templates/tech500/template.json's 'banner' entries) — this mirrors that convention 1:1 so a template built from this library section needs no new fill logic.
